description: Teamsters General President Sean M. O'Brien visited Pennsylvania's Eighth Congressional District today alongside Congressman Rob Bresnahan, underscoring their shared commitment to delivering results for working people and celebrating recent victories for Teamsters members in Northeastern Pennsylvania.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Rob for PA
title: Teamsters President Sean O'Brien Visits Northeastern Pennsylvania with Rep. Rob Bresnahan to Highlight Wins for Workers - Rob for PA
